test_title: PYST 22: RRB NTPC Graduate Level CBT-I - Mathematics (Held On: 14 Jun, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: maths
question: Two taps can fill a cistern in 2 hours and 81 hours, respectively. A third tap can empty it in 81 hours. How long (in hours) will it take to fill the empty cistern, if all of the taps are opened together?
solution:
**Given:**

Tap A fills in = 2 hours

Tap B fills in = 81 hours

Tap C empties in = 81 hours

**Formula used:**

Work per hour = 1 / Time

Time = Total work / Net work per hour

**Calculation:**

Total work = LCM of 2 and 81 = 162 units

⇒ Tap A fills = 162 ÷ 2 = 81 units/hour

⇒ Tap B fills = 162 ÷ 81 = 2 units/hour

⇒ Tap C empties = 162 ÷ 81 = 2 units/hour

Net work/hour = 81 + 2 - 2 = 81 units/hour

Time = 162 ÷ 81 = 2 hours

**∴ Required time = 2 hours**
